src: one-cell-thick colored line network with singleton red/yellow marker pixels
transform: replace each marker by its assigned line color, fill facing horizontal/vertical gaps, and use yellow controls to erase the old arm and paint the same color from the endpoint through the marker to the grid edge
notes: crossings prefer yellow-control rays; otherwise original-vs-filled crossings use the more fragmented repaired line, and marker-bracketed filled gaps beat unmarked pure fills
